apps.message:
fix: limits are a text per language

## Intent

main went red after the limits field (apps#35) met the English translation (apps#32). The limits test rendered the fitness macro without the language data, and English pages showed the limits as plain German.

## Key changes

- limits may be a string (German) or { de, en }, like the other texts of an entry.
- An English page without a translation shows the German text marked lang="de".
- The limits test renders the page template with the language data.
